{"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D21","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 8 H7 THRU` "},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"IZBP"}],"comment":"The ⌀8 H7 hole (D21) carries a tight fit tolerance but the part is zinc-plated (IZBP per title block surface_treatment), and no note or dimension accounts for plating thickness in the bore. The plating buildup will shrink the hole below its H7 limit, preventing the mating pin from assembling; the designer must either add a pre-plate machining allowance to the bore diameter or call out masking of the holes before plating."
    ,"recommended_correction":"Add a note specifying that the ⌀8 H7 holes are to be machined after plating, or increase the bore size by twice the maximum plating thickness, or mask the holes during IZBP plating."}]}
